facts.label: Planets
facts.value: One giant, about 7 times the star's width

controls.label: Colour
controls.qualification: Gaia DR3 spectrum colour on a uniform disc. The disc is unresolved; no limb darkening or rotation axis is measured.
controls.notes: No image of this white dwarf exists: at 24.76 parsecs its disc is about 4.5 microarcseconds across. The colour is its measured Gaia spectrum through the CIE 1931 observer. The disc is drawn without limb darkening: the only law fitted to its transits (Gendreau-Distler et al. 2026, Bessel R, u1 = u2 = 0.52) puts the edge below zero brightness, so it cannot be drawn.
